comment: Copy to users.json and fill in real logins. 'raiser' creates the indent. Every account in 'approvers' is tried against /api/workflow/pending at each rung, so the ladder can change without touching the test. Add the whole approval population here. Optional 'position' picks which hat the person wears — scope and permissions follow the active position, so someone can be blind to a document under one and own it under another.
